# Experiment 2: remaining budget from Stage 1's measurements (generated by scripts/s2_e2_rebudget.py)

The cost model of [budget.md](budget.md), with the same design and formulas. Its projected inputs are replaced by what Stage 1 measured. A10G at 1.00 USD per hour.

## Inputs

| quantity | the plan assumed | Stage 1 measured | source |
|---|---|---|---|
| greedy scoring against Experiment 1 | 4 times faster (target), 1 to 10 in the scenarios | **2.48 times faster**: 0.654 s per own-family episode against 1.62 | calibration, two adapters, 800 episodes |
| a sampled practice attempt | 1.25 greedy `test_id` episodes (0.45 s at the target) | **0.364 s** (0.63 of a greedy `test_id` episode on this engine; most failing attempts end early) | yield probe, 1,600 attempts |
| yield, accepted tasks per attempted task | 40% (20% to 60%) | **33.2%** with the seed adapter, cycle 1 | yield probe, 400 tasks |
| training | 3.91 s per step | **3.60 s per step** on a cycle-1 buffer; no saving from lighter gradient checkpointing | training benchmark |
| job overhead (start-up, installation, loading, per-minute billing) | x1.10 | **x1.15** | billed against useful seconds, dev and probe job |
| contingency for failed and repeated jobs | x1.25 | x1.25 kept; 4% of Stage 1's bill went to its one failed job | ledger |

Scoring times of the splits not timed in Stage 1 are Experiment 1's divided by the measured speed-up. As a cross-check, `dev` took 0.42 s per episode for the seed adapter, against 0.69 s in the model, which is for a fully trained adapter that runs more turns.

## Remaining stages (USD, including overhead and contingency)

Stage 1 has cost 2.04 USD so far. The plan's figures are those of its planning row (engine four times faster, yield 40%).

| scenario | Stage 2 pilot | Stage 3A | Stage 3B | **Stages 2-3** | extension (replicates 5-7) | tasks attempted per cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| *the plan's planning row, for reference* | 3 | 107 | 52 | **162** | 77 | 1,200 |
| **as measured in Stage 1** (seed adapter: yield 33%, 0.36 s per attempt) | 3 | 140 | 70 | **214** | 100 | 1,444 |
| yield at the pilot's floor (20%), attempts as measured | 4 | 160 | 84 | **248** | 120 | 2,400 |
| yield as measured, every attempt as long as a completed episode | 4 | 178 | 92 | **274** | 132 | 1,444 |
| yield at the floor and every attempt as long as a completed episode | 7 | 218 | 118 | **343** | 172 | 2,400 |
| yield 50% in later cycles, attempts as measured | 2 | 130 | 64 | **196** | 90 | 960 |
| as measured, sealed splits also on the new engine (needs a decision: see below) | 3 | 115 | 57 | **176** | 84 | 1,444 |

The first row is what the measurements say about cycle 1. Later cycles are not measured: a better adapter is accepted on more tasks (fewer attempts per cycle) and finishes more of its attempts (longer attempts). The third row is the upper bound on the second effect with no credit for the first.

**Sealed splits.** The plan lets sealed splits be scored on the new engine only if its calibration passes. It met both outcome criteria (at most 1% of outcomes changed, success within 1 point) and missed the speed criterion, so every row but the last costs the sealed splits and the v1 anchor on the Experiment 1 path, as the rule is written. The last row shows what a decision to use the new engine for them would save: 38 USD over Stages 2-3.

## Teacher demonstrations (Stage 4, only if H2(a) holds and a teacher qualifies)

From the qualification runs, at the acceptance and speed each model showed on 200 practice tasks, with overhead and contingency. The plan runs five replicates if the demonstrations cost at most 60 USD, otherwise three.

| model | qualifies | accepted | at four hops | USD per hour | s per attempt | USD per accepted demonstration | five replicates (14,400) | three replicates (8,640) |

| Qwen3-14B | no | 61% | 30% | 1.80 | 2.4 | 0.0040 | 57 | 34 |
| Qwen3-32B | yes | 78% | 58% | 2.50 | 4.4 | 0.0071 | 102 | 61 |

## The 1.5B scoring Experiment 1 left out (approved for planning, not run)

Six adapters on `dev`, `test_depth`, `test_tool` and `test_domain` (10,800 episodes) and the v1 anchor for the two untrained baselines (1,440 episodes).

| item | USD |
|---|---|
| six adapters, four splits, on the calibrated engine | 3.30 |
| two untrained baselines, v1 anchor (assumes the same speed-up for long malformed output, not measured) | 0.49 |
| **total** | **3.79** |
| the same on the Experiment 1 scoring path, which is what the plan's rule prescribes after a missed speed criterion (the plan's 9.02 USD at the measured overhead) | 9.41 |
| the part Stage 1's criterion (c) needs: `dev` for the three 1,600-family adapters | 0.50 |

Which of the two totals applies is the same decision as for the main run's sealed splits, above.
